subject: Capturing condition messages generated by gdistsamp

messages.author: 3fcf0e009c95d23e
messages.subject: Capturing condition messages generated by gdistsamp
parts:
I am trying to catch errors and warnings generated by gdistsamp and write them to a log.  The code below works for many errors and warnings (e.g. "Hessian is singular", "NaNs produced").  After I catch the condition messages I am able to rerun the models with starting values, which has worked in every case so far.

  gds.result <- withCallingHandlers( {
        gdistsamp(lambdaformula,~1,pformula,data=umf, mixture=mixture,keyfun=keyfun,
                  output="density", unitsOut="ha", starts=starts, ...) }
  } , error = function(ex) { gds.warnings <<- c(gds.warnings, conditionMessage(ex))
  } , warning = function(ex) { gds.warnings <<- c(gds.warnings, conditionMessage(ex)) 
  } )

The problem is that I have noticed some warnings are not captured.  One, for example, says "In dnbinom(x, mu = lambda, size = exp(pars[nP])) : NaNs produced".

If I run the gdistsamp function by itself, these warnings appear in R console in red (I'm using RStudio). But they are not caught by withCallingHandlers.  In fact they do not even print in the console if they are wrapped in withCallingHandlers.  I don't know why not because I'm not using invokeRestart("muffleWarning").  The other way to get the messages to appear again is to run fitList(fits=models)

Does anyone have any experience with error handling who could offer suggestions?

Many thanks,
Chris
